## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n = +3.2×10¹² (0→10 T) and hole n = −1.2×10¹² (10→0.3 T)

Raw MR first (top), then the 1/B FFT (bottom). Onset comes from `sdh_onset` on the uniformly sampled part of each record. In run 6 that means B ≥ 1 T; below 1 T the 50 mT grid aliases the 7 T tone.

**Read, electron side (run 6), F_L = 33.1 T:** there are oscillations. The resolved tones are **7.3 T** (strongest, and still above threshold at the 1.0 T edge of the record, so its onset is < 1 T), **22.3 T** (onset 1.40 T) and **29.4 T** (onset 1.76 T), plus 14.8 T. Above ~3 T the QH minima turn sharp and their harmonics (43.7, 58.6, 88, 130 T) make everything above 5 T harmonic-rich. The screen marks everything as a comb of 7.3 T (3× = 22, 4× = 29.4), but the recipe warns about exactly this. The ABAB model at scale 1 gives **7.31 / 25.78 T**. The measured light tone matches it, and 7.3 + 22.3 = **29.6 ≈ the 29.4 T tone**. So {7.3, 22.3} is a candidate ABAB pair whose sum sits at 29.5 T, which would imply a density scale ≈ 0.89. On that reading the 29.4 T tone is either a sum/breakdown orbit or an ABCA-domain singleton at F_L. **Fork, unresolved at one density:** "ABAB pair + sum tone at scale 0.89" vs "one 7.3 T tone plus its harmonics".

**Read, hole side (run 7), F_L = 12.4 T:** tones at 6.6 T (onset 0.71 T), 4.7 T, 8.5 T and 12.3 T. This density is in the recipe's near-CNP hole exception regime: the model ABAB pair is 5.9 / 6.5 T, close and balanced. That makes it a **preview only**. Also, its 12.3 T tone sits at F_L on scale 1.0, while the electron-side sum sits at scale 0.89. One global scale can't fit both "F_L-tone" readings, so the scale has to be pinned independently.

**Take → the fan (investigation Step 4):**
- **Side: electron.** On the hole side the D = 0 line ends at −1.27×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit, fixed), so that side never leaves the exception regime.
- **Density window: n = 1.6 → 3.2×10¹².** Across it the ABAB heavy/light ratio should move ≈ 6 → 3.5. A harmonic comb keeps a fixed 3×. The two readings differ in n-dependence, not at any single density.
- **High-field rows.** The QH ν-rays (n = ν·eB/h) pin the absolute density scale. That settles the 0.89-vs-1.0 question independently of the tone set.

"""Runs 6 (electron, n=+3.2e12) + 7 (hole, n=-1.2e12) — sdh-spot-check read. Raw first, then onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L and the model."""
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

spots = {6: (+3.2, 1.0), 7: (-1.2, 0.3)}   # n (1e12), b_lo for onset = low edge of the uniformly-sampled record
def trace(i):
    r = run(i); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain)
    o = np.argsort(B); return r, B[o], R[o]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for j, (rid, (n12, blo)) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r, B, R = trace(rid)
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16))
    ab = fsm.abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)[1]
    print(f"--- run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0; F_L = {FL:.2f} T; model ABAB orbits {[round(f, 2) for f, _ in ab]} T, ABCA {FL:.2f} T; "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (FS 5000)")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=blo, r_full_scale=5000.0)
    for x in w: print("  warn:", x.message)
    print(on.summary())
    for lo, hi in ((max(blo, 1.0), 5.0), (1.4, 10.0)):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=4096)
        ax[1, j].plot(f, sp[0] / sp[0][f > 2].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"B {lo:.1f}-{hi:.0f} T (dF {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T)")
    ax[1, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label="F_L (scale 1)")
    for fa, _ in ab: ax[1, j].axvline(fa, color="C3", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[1, j].plot([], [], "C3:", label="ABAB model (scale 1)")
    ax[1, j].set_xlim(0, 2.2 * FL); ax[1, j].set_ylim(0, 1.1); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("sdh-spot-check runs 6/7 (sr1 B_1-B_2, 10 nA, T = 1.17-1.29 K)"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — per-column FFT for the stacking call

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti e-side: D=0, n +1.6..+3.2e12 (41, dn 0.04), B 1.0->10.0 T uniform 1/B (114 rows, d(1/B) 0.0080), sr1 50 uV, fast 1.8 s / slow 3 s; ends 10 T, gates 0 · **ETA ~09:36** (≈4h10m)

The spot checks (ana, runs 6–7) leave a fork at n = +3.2×10¹². The tones {7.3, 22.3, 29.4 T} read either as an **ABAB pair** (model 7.31 / 25.78 T) with a sum tone at 29.5 T (density scale ≈ 0.89), or as **one 7.3 T tone plus harmonics**. The fan separates them through n-dependence. From n = 1.6 to 3.2×10¹² the ABAB heavy/light ratio should move ≈ 6 → 3.5, a harmonic comb stays locked at 3×/4×, and an ABCA singleton tracks F_L. The high-field rows pin the absolute density scale from the QH ν-rays (n = ν·eB/h), which the Luttinger read needs (investigation: "pin the scale before you reject").

**Design (landau-fan step 1 checks, computed):**
- **Nyquist, B-axis:** uniform in 1/B with **Δ(1/B) = 0.0080 T⁻¹** (sampling rate 125 T, Nyquist 63 T). That is 3.8 samples per period of F_L(3.2) = 33.1 T, and it keeps run 6's 58.6 T second harmonic un-aliased.
- **Nyquist, n-axis:** **Δn = 0.04×10¹²**, which is 2.4 points per ν-ray at B_lo (0.097×10¹² at 1 T).
- **Field window:** **B_lo = 1.0 T** is the `sdh_onset` value on run 6's 10 mT record. It is censored: the 7.3 T tone is still alive at the record edge. **B_hi = 10 T.** The FFT claim window is 1–5 T (δF = 1.25 T; above ~5 T the QH minima turn harmonic-rich). The 5–10 T rows are for the ν-ray scale and the ν = 8/12/16 layer-number ladder.
- **Settling:** fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB) per the fan recipe's per-column-FFT rule. Along-n lag costs ≲ 12 % of the fastest tone's amplitude at its onset and vanishes above it. slow_delay 3 s = 10τ after each flyback.
- **Dynamic range:** sr1 **50 µV = 5 kΩ full scale**, inherited from the spot checks. Worst corner is low n × 10 T: R₀(1.6) = 83 Ω (run 5) × low-n MR ×4–10 ≈ 0.3–1 kΩ, which leaves ≥ 5× headroom. A rail warning prints; it does not interrupt.

**Coverage trade, stated:**
- **Hole side excluded.** The D = 0 line stops at −1.27×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit), which is inside the near-CNP exception regime, so no hole density there separates the templates.
- **n < 1.6×10¹² excluded.** There the ABAB heavy tone sits within ~15 % of F_L, and the partner (< 2.3 T) can't be resolved in this window.
- **Partner onset below 1 T not pinned.** Extending to B_lo = 0.8 T would buy +28 % partner record for **+31 rows ≈ +45 min**. Not taken: at n ≥ 2.8 the partner already gets ≥ 5 periods, and the discriminating heavy / F_L tones only start at 1.4–1.8 T.

**Price:** 114 rows × (41 × 1.9 s + ~9 s turnaround), with t_pt calibrated from run 5 (1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0) and turnaround from run 5's 5.8 s plus the 3.1 s magnet settle from run 6. That gives 2.75 h of grid, plus the 9 T traverse (66 min), the 0→1 T positioning (7 min) and ~5 % overrun margin.

**Checkpoints:**
- **First rows (B ≈ 1.0 T):** signal, noise, leakage, T.
- **~1.5 h (B ≈ 2 T, row 63):** partial per-column FFT on 1–2 T. Stop if no column shows oscillation content by then; the read would be resolution-limited.
- **~3.2 h (B = 5 T, row 101):** the claim window is complete, so run the preliminary per-column F(n) read.

**End state:** B = 10 T, gates parked at 0. The next step (LK split / grid-change reproduction) rides the field down.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — per-column SdH-FFT fan for the stacking call ===
# B slow 1.0 -> 10.0 T uniform in 1/B (114 rows, d(1/B) = 0.0080 T^-1); n fast +1.6 -> +3.2e12 at D = 0 (41 pts, dn = 0.04e12).
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.round(np.linspace(1.6, 3.2, 41), 4)          # 1e12 cm^-2, fast axis ascending
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                               # D = 0 V/nm (R_CNP(D) vertex, run 5)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
_rt = calc_nD(Vtgs[[0, -1]], Vbgs[[0, -1]], CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"n-line: {len(ns)} pts, n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 (dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.3f}), D = 0; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; roundtrip ends n,D = {np.round(_rt, 4).tolist()}")

B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 114)                   # ascending (magnet sits at 0 T); ends at 10 T for the next step
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and np.abs(B_vec).max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, d(1/B) = {abs(1/B_vec[1]-1/B_vec[0]):.5f} T^-1 "
      f"(Nyquist {0.5/abs(1/B_vec[1]-1/B_vec[0]):.1f} T), dB {B_vec[1]-B_vec[0]:.4f} ... {B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2]:.3f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
# dwell is priced against tau = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct and I_bias = 10 nA — read, don't assume
print(f"lock-in: drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz; sr1 tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"sr0 tau {sr0.time_constant()} s, sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24
assert sr0.sensitivity() >= 0.02   # drain 10 nA x 1e6 = 10 mV

# --- fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (inherits the spot checks' 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA) ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
R_FS = sr1.sensitivity() / (sr1.amplitude() / 100e6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 3.0                    # 6 tau (per-column-FFT fan); 10 tau after each row's flyback
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V -> FS {R_FS:.0f} Ohm; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n +1.6..+3.2e12 (41), B 1.0->10.0 T uniform 1/B (114), run-5 cal, "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast 1.8 s / slow 3 s, T {_T0:.3f} K")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 V/nm, n = +1.6 to +3.2e12 cm^-2 (41 pts, dn 0.04), B = 1.0 to 10.0 T uniform in 1/B (114 rows, d(1/B) 0.0080); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'purpose: tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4 per-column FFT + nu-ray scale pin')

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_bg.volt, k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_ix = {}
_rail = {"n": 0, "B": None}
def fan_guard(station, data, writer):
    if not _ix:
        cols = writer.metadata["columns"]
        _ix.update(tg=cols.index("k_2400_tg_curr"), bg=cols.index("k_2400_bg_curr"), x=cols.index("sr1_X"), B=cols.index("magnet_field"))
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[_ix["tg"]])), abs(float(data[_ix["bg"]]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[_ix['B']]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(float(data[_ix["x"]])) > 0.9 * sr1.sensitivity():   # rail warning only (clip = lost columns, not a hazard)
        _rail["n"] += 1
        if _rail["B"] != float(data[_ix["B"]]):
            _rail["B"] = float(data[_ix["B"]]); print(f"RAIL WARN: |sr1.X| > 90% FS at B = {_rail['B']:.3f} T, Vtg = {float(data[2]):+.4f} (count {_rail['n']})")
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

# position: gates to the line start, magnet to B_lo (blocking ramp ~7 min from 0 T), then the fan
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # park gates; the field stays where the fan ended (10 T on completion) — the next step rides it down, never re-traverses
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K, rail count {_rail['n']}")
